Square used for many events, including Labor Day celebrations, plus celebrations of association football victories. It also contains the 14-Bis monument, a replica of the aircraft constructed by the Brazilian inventor Alberto…
Linked to Campo de Bagatelle Square by a 1km stretch, this one contains a monument for the Brazilians who fought in World War II.

The 240,000-m² park is the former location of the Carandiru penitentiary complex, which in 1992 was the site of a massacre where over a hundred inmates were killed by the police during a riot. Most of the former penitentiary was…

Founded by Italian immigrants, the sports club is famous for its rowing activities, which was originally practiced in the Tietê river, now inside the University of São Paulo. Many other sport activities are also available.
Guided helicopter ride, to see the great views of São Paulo from above. Around 30 minutes a trip.
Aeromodelling club, where people build small aircraft and test it together.
General aviation club. Commercial pilot classes available.

Brazilian panquecas (pancakes) are eaten more like crepes on a plate, rolled into a tube shape with savory or sweet fillings inside, topped with sauce. This restaurant offers solid pancakes alongside pasta and grilled dishes.
Enjoy a drink while watching soccer, with straightforward bar snacks available. Coming on match day is recommended if you wanna mingle with the locals.
Brick walls enclose the cozy ambiance and pleasant drinks. The meals are expensive but easily feed two people.
Concert hall focused on small local artists, with drinks available on site.
